blocks.html:
Tuition fees for the Master's degree amount to Euro 3’000 per semester.

Tuition fees have to be paid to Università Cattolica del Sacro Cuore:

  1. The first instalment always amounts to € 1.470, to be paid upon admission
  2. Second instalment due in January
  3. Third instalment due in February
  4. Fourth instalment due in April
  5. Fifth instalment due in May

Instalments following the first one cannot be paid by bank transfer. They will have to be paid by "Bollettino MAV", a payment slip downloadable from iCatt (students' personal webpage after enrolment) and accepted by Italian banks only, which is also payable online by credit card.

Grants

Scholarships at Università Cattolica del Sacro Cuore

For detailed information on grants available at Università Cattolica del Sacro Cuore, please refer to Università Cattolica scholarships webpage (in Italian only) or visit the EDUCATT website (in Italian and English).
